```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Map Tiles

plotly.core bundles plotly.js 4, where the Mapbox-based traces were replaced by MapLibre-based "map" traces. The `"open-street-map"` and `carto-*` styles need no access token. See [Map Layers](mapbox-layers.html) for more information.

### Lines on tile maps using "Scattermap" traces

To draw a line on your map, you either can use `add_scattermap()` (see `go_scattermap()`) or `add_scattergeo()` (see `go_scattergeo()`) in plotly.core. This example uses scattermap and sets the drawing `mode` to the combination of markers and lines.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scattermap(
    mode = "markers+lines",
    lon = c(10, 20, 30),
    lat = c(10, 20, 30),
    marker = go_scattermap_marker(size = 10)
  ) |>
  add_scattermap(
    mode = "markers+lines",
    lon = c(-50, -60, 40),
    lat = c(30, 10, -20),
    marker = go_scattermap_marker(size = 10)
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    map = go_map(
      style = "carto-voyager",
      center = go_map_center(lon = 10, lat = 10),
      zoom = 1
    ),
    margin = go_margin(l = 0, t = 0, b = 0, r = 0)
  )
```
#Reference

See `go_scattermap()` for more information and options!
